_about: D-09 dummy-data generation behaviour. Ported from 01a93e17216faea7bfc156b0f864cbbe420d1c52
_method: Values produced by executing the named Python code under pi_dash.settings.test with no DB/S3 (venv /tmp/ct100-django-venv). Generators: /tmp/fx_d09b.py, /tmp/fx_d09c.py (throwaway). Randomness protocol derived from source; Faker unavailable in this env so fake values are NOT recorded — only counts, seeds, ranges and row shapes.
create_project: name=fake.name(); suffix=uuid4hex[:5]; name=f'{name}_{suffix}'; identifier=name[:randint(2, min(12, len-1))].upper(); intake_view=True; creator added as ProjectMember role 20.
create_project_members: User filter(email__in=members); bulk role-20 rows with sort_order randint(0,65535), ignore_conflicts.
create_labels: Faker.seed(0); 50 x Label(color_name, hex_color, sort randint, ignore_conflicts).
create_cycles_BUG: while len(cycles) <= cycle_count -> creates cycle_count+1 rows (off-by-one, port as-is). start None-or-date_this_year; end None iff start None; unique (start,end) enforced for dated pairs; ignore_conflicts.
create_modules: Faker.seed(0); range(module_count); dated-or-None same as cycles.
create_pages: Faker.seed(0); range(pages_count); text<=60000 chars; access randint(0,1); ProjectPage per page, batch 1000.
create_page_labels: labels of project; sample int(pages_count/2) pages; per page sample(randint(0, len(labels)-1)) labels — never attaches ALL labels; batch 1000.
create_issues: Faker.seed(0); states exclude TRIAGE group; creators = project members; sequence from Max+1 (1 when none); sort from Max+10000 (65535 when none) then += randint(0,1000) per row; priority in [urgent,high,medium,low,none]; name=text[:254] (~byte slice on PY str = code points); bulk_create batch 1000 ignore_conflicts; IssueSequence(sequence=sequence_id) batch 100; IssueActivity(verb/created) batch 100.
create_intake_issues: calls create_issues(..., intake_issue_count) then links ALL returned issues to the default Intake (get_or_create name='Intake'); status in [-2,-1,0,1,2]; snoozed_till=now+randint(1,30)d IFF status==0; source IN_APP.
create_issue_parent_BUG: parent_count=issue_count/4; sub_issues slice issue_count/2; loop sets sub_issue.parent_id IN MEMORY but appends NOTHING to bulk_sub_issues, then bulk_update([], ['parent']) — NO parent is EVER persisted. Port as-is (no-op).
create_issue_assignees: sample(issue_count/2 issues); per issue sample(randint(0, len(assignees)-1)) members; batch 1000 ignore_conflicts.
create_issue_labels: ALL project issues (commented-out sampling left in place); per issue shuffle + sample(randint(0,5)) labels; batch 1000 ignore_conflicts.
create_cycle_issues: sample(issue_count/2); one random cycle per issue (cycles[randint] — IndexError when project has NO cycles; port as-is).
create_module_issues: ALL issues; per issue shuffle + sample(randint(0,5)) modules.
randomness_note: Faker.seed(0) before labels/cycles/modules/pages/issues (seeded); the `random` module is NEVER seeded -> names/identifiers/counts/slices differ every run. Port the unseeded randomness as-is (ported bug per PIDASHCONV-191).

db_before_after.before: Workspace + one user; counts (issue, cycle, module, pages, intake_issue).
db_before_after.after: 1 project (+1 member row per member email); 5 states; 50 labels; cycle_count+1 cycles; module_count modules; pages_count pages (+links); issue_count issues (+sequences/activities) + intake_issue_count intake issues (+links); parent links ABSENT (bug); random assignee/label/cycle/module links as above.
